name: Bunni
source:
Time Suit: Bunny girl outfit 
Interests: Gymnastics 
Likes: Cocktails

A tall and seductive girl who is also a part of Chrontek, the enemies of the Time Tenshi. Don't take her lack of weapons for a weakness - she uses her long legs to great effect with a dangerous array of kicks, holds and strikes!

[Taken from [url=https://c1.iggcdn.com/indiegogo-media-prod-cld/image/upload/c_limit,w_620/v1463768454/character_5_full_ofkthj.png]Indiegogo Character Bio[/url]]
